## Easing curves (`EASE.<name>`)

`linear`, `outExpo`, `outQuint`, `outCubic`, `outBack`, `inQuad`, `inCubic`, `inOutCubic`, `anticipate`, `crispEnter`, `editorial`, `pop`

## Functions in scope inside a `custom_*` scene

Core functions: `cubicBezier`, `interpolate`, `spring`, `stagger`

Composed functions: `phase`, `staggerWindow`, `punch`, `cascade`, `typewriter`, `countUp`, `center`, `glow`, `softShadow`, `vignette`, `meshGradient`, `grain`, `drift`, `pathDraw`, `orbit`, `morph`, `sweep`, `rand01`, `particles`, `burst`

After mapping the `@vanillasky` namespace in `components.json` as described
in the catalog, install the complete surface with `npx shadcn add @vanillasky/motion`.
